why: OpenAI-compat tools param via LiteLLM to ollama/vLLM; streaming; hermes_tool_parser

tool_calling_support.transport_chain: omp (openai-completions api, tools param) -> LiteLLM :4000 /v1/chat/completions (drop_params strips non-supported fields; supports_function_calling declared in model_info) -> backend (vLLM with hermes parser OR Ollama native tools)
tool_calling_support.openai_wire_format: tools: [{type: function, function: {name, description, parameters(JSON Schema)}}], tool_choice: auto|required|none|named; response carries choices[0].message.tool_calls[].function.{name,arguments(JSON string)}; tool results returned as role:tool messages with tool_call_id
tool_calling_support.litellm_pass_through: LiteLLM forwards tools/tool_choice unchanged for openai/<model> routes; drop_params + additional_drop_params (web_search_options) remove params the backend rejects instead of erroring; parse_tool_call_from_content: true (used on some NexGate routes e.g. glm-5.1) recovers tool calls emitted as raw text in content — NOT set on the coopforge/bielik route
vllm_requirements: --tool-call-parser hermes (matches Hermes-format models; alternatives: llama3_json, mistral, pythonic, llama4_pythonic, glm47, hf, beam)
--chat-template with tool-use support when tokenizer_config.json lacks one
strictness: VLLM_ENFORCE_STRICT_TOOL_CALLING=true default; --tool-strict-level function raises server floor so envelope markup stays valid even when client omits strict
tool_calling_support.ollama_requirements: tools param native since 2024-07 (Llama 3.1 era); OpenAI-compat /v1 endpoint accepts tools too; supported models answer with tool_calls; no parser flags; verify specific GGUF carries tools capability (Tools category on ollama.com)
tool_calling_support.bielik_status: coopforge/bielik-minitron-7b: curl gate 20/20 valid tool_calls with 1 simple tool (get_time) and short prompt; but suite edit tasks 0/8 pass — suspected old model version without properly trained tool-calling; candidate replacement Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0-Instruct with official tool-calling (speakleash/bielik-tools) [uncertain coopforge_model_version, coopforge_tool_calling_native]

tool_call_rate.curl_gate: tests/bielik-gateway-test.sh: 20 calls, 1 tool (get_time), tool_choice auto, max_tokens 256, timeout 60s; valid = tool_calls[0].function present + arguments parseable JSON (empty arguments also counted valid); threshold >=90% PASS
tool_call_rate.curl_gate_result: 20/20 valid, 0 malformed, 100.0% — PASS (single-tool, short-prompt regime only)
tool_call_rate.suite_results: omp-bielik-tasks.sh 12 tasks (4 edit + 8 cli/log/git): v1 broad-tools 33% (cancelled 9/12, all 4 edit FAIL, wall 199-301s); v2 narrow-tools 16% (2/12 pass: cli-grep, cli-git-status; edit 0/4)
tool_call_rate.stability: inconsistent between variants — v1 33% vs v2 16%; edit tasks never pass in either; many wall times hit ~300s TASK_TIMEOUT ceiling indicating timeout-class failures

streaming_behavior.litellm_streaming: stream=True supported in SDK and proxy; chunks carry delta.content; stream_chunk_builder rebuilds full response from chunk list; REPEATED_STREAMING_CHUNK_LIMIT (default 100) raises InternalServerError on model loops to enable retry logic
streaming_behavior.router_stream_timeout: NexGate router_settings.stream_timeout: 1800s — long generations on slow GPU backends deliberately not cut; deployments carry own timeouts
streaming_behavior.tool_calls_in_stream: OpenAI streaming protocol delivers tool_calls as delta.tool_calls fragments (id/function.name first chunk, arguments string accumulated across chunks); LiteLLM aggregates these for openai-compatible backends; vLLM hermes parser emits each tool call whole once its region parses (a call cut before its closer is parsed from text so far; unparseable call dropped); Ollama streamed tool calls were a 2024 future-improvement item and have since landed for supported models [uncertain — verify on target version]
streaming_behavior.timeout_at_2_4k_tokens: No doc'd tool-call-specific timeout at 2.4k+ tokens; observed suite wall times cluster 200-300s at TASK_TIMEOUT; vLLM parsing is per-request so tool_call survival does not inherently degrade with length, but slow 7B backends can exceed client timeouts — NexGate mitigates with stream_timeout 1800 and per-deployment timeout 60-1800s + num_retries 0-5

pass_criteria.suite_target: >=80% of 12 tasks; <=1 retry per task; <=2 tool-errors per task
failure_classification: timeout: wall_s ~= 300 (TASK_TIMEOUT) with no file mutation — dominant class in v1/v2 (edit-add-function 301s, edit-rename-var 294-300s, log-tail 215-300s)

no-tool-call: model answers in text without invoking edit/bash tool — suspected for failed edit tasks given curl gate passes only in 1-tool regime; multi-tool + long prompt likely exceeds untrained tool-calling ability
hallucination: model claims action not performed — not directly evidenced in results JSONs; requires transcript inspection [uncertain]
pass_criteria.gate_thresholds: curl pre-flight >=90% tool-call validity (measured 100%); suite >=80%; both recorded as project stop/go gates (GATE: FAIL prints 'STOP projektu')
